About Test Yourself: Vocabulary

An adaptive vocabulary check. It draws on Days of the Week, Months, Weather, Fruits, Parts of the Body, Clothes, Question Words, Sight Words, Picture and Word, Devices, All Spelling, Odd One Out and Translate.

How to play

  1. Answer each round.
  2. The test changes to match you.
  3. See your results.

Play it as a class

Students take it on their own phones. It shows which topics each one already knows.
